notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around ordinary attribute reflection. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies ordinary attribute delivery, callback suppression, callback release after re-enable, callback-model servicing, handle identity, user data, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with ordinary updateAttributeValues and FederateAmbassador reflectAttributeValues delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and ordinary attribute-update declarations
